summary.answer: Common Hud constructs this front safe-area wrapper directly. Builds playercard, ability callout queue and prone-blocked help child. MPSplitscreen requires IsMultiplayer and IsSplitscreenAndInGame; lobbyNav notifications reevaluate state. CallOriginalSecond close registers self.__onClose, whose unselected outside body is a dependency. Optional postload then self return. Does not itself establish screen-safe coordinates or child gameplay subscriptions.
